# Ice IQ — Hockey IQ App with AI Hockey Coach

Ice IQ (iceiq.app) is a hockey IQ app for parents, players, and coaches. You
log what the player actually did in a real game, in under two minutes, and an
AI hockey coach turns it into concrete advice and one thing to work on next.
Over a season it shows how the player develops compared with themselves.
Available in English and Swedish, in any phone browser.

## How Ice IQ differs from hockey IQ training apps

Most hockey IQ apps train decisions in made-up situations: quizzes, video
clips, or game-like drills (for example Project Hockey, RinkIQ, Project
Intuition, or Hockey IntelliGym). Ice IQ starts from the player's own games
instead.

- **Scenario trainers** ask "what would you do here?" in a clip someone else
  played.
- **Ice IQ** shows what this player actually did in their last game, which
  choices keep repeating, and whether they are trending up or down against
  their own season average.

The two work well together: train situations in a scenario app, then use Ice
IQ to see whether it shows up in real games. Ice IQ is not a quiz or video
library, and it does not replace on-ice coaching.

## What a parent or coach gets after a game

After logging a game, the AI coach answers in a fixed, short format:

- **Trend**: is the player up or down against their own recent games and
  season average?
- **Strengths**: what worked, backed by the numbers from the game.
- **Focus area**: one concrete thing to practice next.
- **Something to think about**: one calm question about a decision, such as
  "Four turnovers in your own zone. What did you see just before?"

Illustrative example of the format (not a real player):

> Trend: 14 points this game, above your season average of 9.
> Strengths: You won 5 board battles, the most this season.
> Focus area: Turnovers under pressure in the defensive zone. Look up before
> the puck arrives so you know your outlet.

The coach remembers what it has noticed about the player across
conversations, so advice builds over time instead of starting over. It only
uses numbers from the logged games and never compares a child with other
players.

## Features

- Game logging in under two minutes, with button layouts per role
  (forward, center, defenseman, goalie)
- AI hockey coach: post-game analysis plus follow-up questions in a chat
- Mental training mode: short routines for nerves, focus, and letting go of
  a mistake (not therapy, and it asks for no health information)
- Season view: points per game, season-by-season comparison, and individual
  Corsi (shot attempts per game: on goal, missed, and blocked)
- Player link: a page the player can open on their own phone with no login,
  showing a breathing exercise, their progress, and the coach's notes. The
  parent can switch the link off at any time.
- Awards: a hockey gem for each game and an award shelf
- Team and player management, with cloud sync on paid plans
- Money Mode (for parents): optionally turn game performance into pocket
  money, set and controlled by the adult
- Weekly email summary for parents

## Who it is for

- Hockey parents who want to follow their child's development without
  spreadsheets
- Players who want honest feedback on their own games
- Youth coaches tracking a few players or a whole team
- From grassroots youth hockey to competitive teams

## Pricing

Free to start, no card required.

- **Free**: up to 3 saved players, game scoring, game history, 3 AI credits
  per month
- **Premium**: unlimited players, cloud sync, deeper stats and trends, 50 AI
  credits per month
- **Elite**: everything in Premium, 500 AI credits per month, deeper AI
  analyses, priority support

## Not to be confused with

Ice IQ (iceiq.app, by SquareVerse Group AB) is not affiliated with IceIQ
Development (iceiqdevelopment.com) or other services with similar names.

## FAQ

- **What is hockey IQ?** A player's ability to read the game, make quick
  decisions, and position themselves well on the ice. Scenario apps train it
  in made-up situations; Ice IQ shows how those decisions actually play out
  in the player's own games.
- **Is Ice IQ a hockey IQ training app like Project Hockey or RinkIQ?** No,
  it complements them. Those train decisions with quizzes and clips. Ice IQ
  tracks the player's real games and gives AI feedback on what to work on.
- **How does the AI hockey coach work?** After you log a game, it compares
  the game with the player's own history and season average and gives a
  trend, strengths, one focus area, and a question to think about. You can
  ask follow-up questions.
- **How long does logging a game take?** Under two minutes, by tapping
  buttons for what happened during or right after the game.
- **Can my child use it on their own phone?** Yes, through the player link:
  a page with no login that the parent creates and can switch off.
- **Is Ice IQ free?** Yes. The free plan has 3 players and 3 AI credits per
  month. Premium and Elite add more players, cloud sync, and more AI credits.
- **Who is Ice IQ for?** Hockey parents, players, and coaches at every
  level, from grassroots to competitive teams.
